<!--
Write a short, direct PR title. Tell the story in plain language: the specific problem, what changed, and the outcome.
Keep the body short and proportional to the change. A small fix may need only two or three sentences; use a few short paragraphs only when the reviewer needs more context.
Include only context that helps review this PR. Reference relevant Linear issues where they fit in the story, and explain this PR's part of the work. Do not copy the issue description.
Put useful links, user feedback, designs, and @mentions beside the point they support.
Visual proof is required when the change is visible in the product UI (layout, styling, on-page copy, rendered components, OG images, animations, etc.): embed at least one screenshot or short video of the actual result. Backend-only changes (APIs, config, CI, deps, non-UI logic) do not need this. Show before and after when helpful for fixes or redesigns.
Mention open questions only when reviewers need to weigh in. Remove this comment and the prompt below before submitting.
-->

Describe the problem, the change, and its result in a few short sentences.
